text:
Arey yaar, aap fir se wahi repeat kar rahe ho! Maine abhi pucha ki kya hua package ka, aur aapne fir se wahi delivery date bata di. Main subah se ghar pe tha, koi bell nahi baja. 

Mujhe seedha-seedha batao, yeh theft complaint file hui hai ya nahi? Kitni baar bolna padega ki package mila hi nahi? Please check karke batao aur mujhe ghumao mat!
